title: Kopya
setup: May quiz bukas at hindi nakapag-review si Bea, ang kaibigan mong magaling mag-drawing. 'Pahiram ng sagot mo mamaya, isang tingin lang. May utang ako sa'yo, promise.'
setup_en: There's a quiz tomorrow and Bea, your friend who's great at drawing, hasn't reviewed. 'Lend me your answers later, just one peek. I owe you, promise.'

success.text: Napagani mo siya. Pumasa siyang patas.
success.text_en: You convince her. She passes fairly.

fail.text: Naubusan kayo ng oras, pero nag-review pa rin.
fail.text_en: You ran out of time, but you still reviewed.

callback: Utang +1 -> Singil seed. silent_copy -> Ch2 Card 4.
